cases.title: First lesson on Mentor Practice: Title, its pairs, leave-outs, a frame, then the read-the-graph step

rubric.reason: Turn 1 proposes only Title, says it is "the layer you eased before", and names its pairs from the snapshot: "three Position moves, 0.5 to 1.5 s, 1.5 to 3 s and 3 to 4.37 s, plus its Scale from 0.5 to 1.5 s".

Turn 1 gives one short line per left_out kind (hidden Old Take, null CTRL, "I can't see inside Icon yet", "An expression drives Logo's Rotation", the ease-first pairs), never calls the precomp fine, and asks once whether any of Title's moves should land hard.

Turn 2 has the learner open the Graph Editor, choose Edit Speed Graph and say where the 0.5 to 1.5 s move is fastest; Turn 3 takes a frame at 1 s inside that pair and explains influence in plain words ("A short reach out of the first key", "A long reach into the landing key") with no influence or speed numbers.
Turn 1 says "the layer you eased before", matching eased_layers ["Title"] in plain words without reading out record fields or inventing history.

Every name and time the mentor uses (Title, Position, Scale, 0.5/1.5/3/4.37 s, 1 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness) appears in the snapshot or preview_frame results.
